body:
Hi

rfc2 isn't part of the electron transport chain (it's an asssembly factor)

  | CPXP | Q9P3B2 | rcf2 | involved_in | GO:0006123 | mitochondrial electron transport, cytochrome c to oxygen | ECO:0005547(NAS) | ECO:0005547 | (NAS) |   | PMID:37939086


although it does appear in the crystal structure  PMID:37939086
it appears to be involved in assembly rather than directly in " mitochondrial electron transport, cytochrome c to oxygen"

defined"The transfer of electrons from cytochrome c to oxygen that occurs during oxidative phosphorylation, mediated by the multisubunit enzyme known as complex IV"

so I put it in the upstream assembly model, 
https://www.pombase.org/gocam/pombase-view/gene/67e5e74400003073/SPAC1565.01/rcf2

and not in this one:
